intro: Tiny Iceland has made a big mark on football, handball and strength sports.

chapters.title: Football
text: At Euro 2016 Iceland knocked out England and became famous for its 'Viking thunderclap'. In 2018 it became, at the time, the smallest country ever to play at a World Cup, co-coached by a part-time dentist.

chapters.title: Handball and strongmen
text: Handball is hugely popular, and Iceland won Olympic silver in 2008. Icelanders have won the World's Strongest Man title many times, and Icelandic athletes have won the CrossFit Games.

keyTerms.meaning: A sport of feats of strength such as lifting stones and pulling trucks.
